But the root cause is in the upper half when constructing the first_citation_link. If the href already has the protocol, adding it again is incorrect, leading to a malformed URL. So the most critical mistake is in the upper half when constructing the first_citation_link by adding "https://en.wikipedia.org" to the href, which might already have the protocol.
